title: Soreike! Anpanman: Pantan to Yakusoku no Hoshi
native: それいけ！アンパンマン　パンタンと約束の星
synopsis:
Pantan is a red panda who seeks to find the treasure thought to be in a rainbow star in the night sky, in order to keep a promise made to an adventurer long ago. When Pantan and Anpanman encounter each other, Anpanman lends his abilities to help out Pantan.

(Source: Anime News Network)
